name: dev.joselugo/profile
title: José Manuel Gulias Lugo
description: Public profile of José Manuel Gulias Lugo, engineering manager and full stack developer.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Returns the public profile of José Manuel Gulias Lugo: current role, summary, location, focus areas, and links.

tools.name: get_experience
tools.description: Returns José Manuel Gulias Lugo's career timeline: companies (Change.org, Metalab, frog, King Tide, ktc), roles, dates, and selected clients.

tools.name: get_skills
tools.description: Returns José Manuel Gulias Lugo's technical and leadership skills, grouped by category (frontend, backend, infrastructure, design and process, leadership).

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Returns how to reach José Manuel Gulias Lugo: email, 15 or 30 minute booking links, social profiles, and whether José Manuel Gulias Lugo is open to new roles.

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Compares a list of role requirements (skills, technologies, leadership areas) with José Manuel Gulias Lugo's public profile. Returns matched and not-listed items as evidence. It does not score or rank the candidate.

requirements.description: Short requirement phrases, for example ["Next.js", "TypeScript", "engineering management", "GraphQL"].

tools.name: get_now_playing
tools.description: Returns the song José Manuel Gulias Lugo is playing on Spotify right now, or the last song played.
